prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept, identity-preserving game asset.
Create one full-body transparent PNG of Uroboros Mkono, exactly the Resident Evil 5 (2009) incarnation in the attached original reference. The image is an identity, anatomy, palette and material reference, not an edit target and not a background to reproduce. Preserve the crouched, massively hunched black intertwined Uroboros body, low visible head, two extremely long arm/hand supports with their individual finger tips, tucked lower legs/feet, and irregular shoulder/back contour.
Required orientation: an unmistakable THREE-QUARTER RIGHT-FACING combat idle pose. Physically turn the entire body toward the RIGHT edge of the image: head, chest, waist and tucked lower limbs all share the same rightward axis. Show the creature's anatomical LEFT flank as the near side. The several swollen orange rounded growths belong to the anatomical LEFT shoulder/upper arm (on image-right in the original frontal reference); they remain on that same anatomical left arm, now the near-side arm. The leaner anatomical right arm remains far-side. Keep the original fixed proportions, asymmetry and number of limbs; do not exchange the growth-bearing arm, duplicate the growths, mirror the source, or create a symmetrical monster.
Preserve the same crouched weight and recognisable surface structures; rotate the real anatomy in space, not merely the eyes or head. Clean high-fidelity detailed render consistent with the original game's materials; do not modernise its design. No additional tentacles, gear or people. Use a three-quarter view that keeps both hands and both feet legible, including occluded limbs through believable depth, without inventing extra limbs.
Entire single creature from the highest rear mass to every hand, finger and foot tip contained comfortably in the canvas with transparent breathing room on all four sides. Genuine transparent alpha background, no floor, no fog, no cast-shadow backdrop, no frame, no labels, no other view or inset. One figure only. Do not add gore, victims or action effects.

Use case: stylized-concept, identity-preserving game asset.
Create ONE full-body transparent PNG of the exact mutated Lucas Baker boss from Resident Evil 7 Biohazard (2017), Not a Hero, shown in the attached source model render. The reference specifies identity, anatomy, materials and asymmetry. Preserve the large asymmetrical skeletal mutation: the central clustered skull-like head, ribbed narrow trunk, its two small supporting lower legs and feet, and the two distinct huge upper limbs. Anatomical RIGHT arm, on image-left of the frontal source, terminates in the long heavy pale downward blade/point. Anatomical LEFT arm, on image-right of that source, is the thick dark mouth-bearing curled structure with its hooked thin lower projections. Keep these two very different arms on their original anatomical sides. Preserve the original shoulder/back spikes and their attachment pattern; do not substitute a generic Molded enemy or another Lucas form.
Required pose: the ENTIRE creature turned in space into a clear three-quarter RIGHT-FACING combat idle. The face, rib cage, central pelvis, knees and feet all face toward the RIGHT edge of the canvas. Show anatomical LEFT flank nearest the viewer, with the mouth-bearing anatomical left limb near-side and the blade-bearing right limb farther away. This is a real spatial turn of the complete body, not a front view with the head turned, not a reflection, and not a front/back split. Keep both feet and both arm ends readable through sensible overlap. Maintain exactly two upper arms and two supporting legs.
Match the supplied grey-bone, dark mineral-brown and muted red-brown surface palette and proportions without redesign, extra growths or added gore. Detailed game-character render, neutral illumination that reveals existing anatomy. Whole silhouette from every upper spike to both feet and the lowest blade tip entirely inside frame, with transparent margin on all four sides. True alpha transparency, no grey background, floor, vignette, surrounding mist, scene, other character, text, watermark, inset or alternate view. Exactly one full creature in one pose.
